description: This line plot illustrates the Average Correct Gate Rate across 31 embedding layers for four different input configurations in a gated language model, as presented in the paper "Memorization and Knowledge Injection in Gated LLMs". The x-axis, labeled “Embedding Layer”, spans from 0 to 31 with integer tick marks at every 5 units. The y-axis, labeled “Average Correct Gate Rate”, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Four lines are plotted: a solid blue line for “Character Attention input” starts near 0.1 at layer 0, peaks around 0.8 at layer 5, drops to ~0.25 at layer 12, and rises again to ~0.75 by layer 31; a dashed blue line for “Character MLP input” begins at ~0.82, peaks near 0.95 at layer 5, dips to ~0.55 at layer 12, and recovers to ~0.85 by layer 31; a solid red line (with a grayed-out label in the legend) starts at ~0.2, rises steeply to ~0.8 at layer 5, falls to ~0.38 at layer 13, then climbs to ~0.7 by layer 31; and a dashed red line for “Wiki MLP input” begins at ~0.82, peaks near 0.9 at layer 5, dips to ~0.6 at layer 12, and stabilizes around 0.85–0.88 from layer 18 onward. Each line is accompanied by a shaded region representing its standard deviation or confidence interval, with blue lines having light blue shading and red lines having light red shading.
